verdict.rationale: SavvyCal has a public pricing page (savvycal.com/pricing) that lists included features such as unlimited calendars, assistant delegation, custom-domain booking pages and branded email sending, and the teams page names a Premium tier. However, no evidence shows actual prices, per-seat billing, or a clear tier-by-tier breakdown. missing for 10: published dollar amounts per tier, per-seat pricing structure, explicit mapping of features to each tier, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales

citations.quote: Booking pages on your own domainbooking.yourcompany.com/you instead of savvycal.com/you
Unlimited calendarsGoogle, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail, all checked for conflicts
On Premium, host links on your own domain and hide the SavvyCal badge.
